blocks.content: With per-route boundaries, each page gets its own fallback. For a production app, per-route skeletons feel noticeably more professional:

<Routes>

  <Route path="/" element={
      <Suspense fallback={<SkeletonPage />}>
        <HomePage />
      </Suspense>
    }
  />

  <Route path="/entries/:id" element={
      <Suspense fallback={<SkeletonPage />}>
        <EntryDetailPage />
      </Suspense>
    }
  />

  <Route path="*" element={
      <Suspense fallback={<SkeletonPage />}>
        <NotFoundPage />
      </Suspense>
    }
  />

</Routes>
We can also combine the two patterns, which is what most production apps do. Let's see how that works.
